name: Lovesick Mind
source:
After years of separation, Haruko finally meets Nami again – only to realize she’s no longer the most important person in her life.

[From [url=https://hachikoyi.itch.io/lovesick-mind]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阔别多年之后，春子终于与奈美重逢——却恍然发觉，自己早已不再是对方生命中最重要的人了。

[摘自[url=https://hachikoyi.itch.io/lovesick-mind]Itch.io[/url]]
